findings.title: Populate approval choices from the complete owner study list
findings.suggested_fix: In the owner intake initialization, fetch the authenticated general bootstrap and use its complete studies array for the approval selector instead of workspaceBootstrap.studies; preserve the existing server-side study authorization and CAS checks.
findings.first_evidence: app/lib/research-intake-ui.js:122 --       const studies=bootstrap.studies||[],study=D.field(approval,'מחקר לאישור','select',saved?.studyId||'',{choices:{'':'בחירת מחקר',...Object.fromEntries(studies.map(s=>[s.id,s.title||s.config?.title||'מחקר']))}}),identity=D.field(approval,'זהות אישית מאומתת','select',saved?.individualCode||'',{choices:{'':'בחירת קוד אישי',...Object.fromEntries((ownerInfo.identities||[]).map(i=>[i.code,i.label+' · '+i.institution]))}}),verified=D.field(approval,'וידוא זהות הפונה הושלם','checkbox',saved?.verified===true);

findings.title: Refresh a created study revision before each approval
findings.suggested_fix: Always call studyGet for the selected study immediately before constructing the approval payload and use fresh.study.revision, rather than refreshing only when the cached revision is missing.
findings.first_evidence: app/lib/research-intake-ui.js:129 --       approval.append(D.button('אישור הבקשה וההרשאות שנבחרו',async()=>{if(!study.value||!identity.value||!verified.checked||!rights.values().includes('view_study')){note('להשלמת האישור אפשר לבחור מחקר, זהות אישית שנבדקה והרשאת צפייה במחקר, ולסמן את וידוא הזהות.',true);return;}let selected=(bootstrap.studies||[]).find(s=>s.id===study.value);if(!Number.isSafeInteger(selected?.revision)){const fresh=await call('studyGet',{studyId:study.value});if(!fresh)return;selected=fresh.study;}await review('approved',{studyId:study.value,studyExpectedRevision:selected.revision,individualCode:identity.value,permissions:rights.values()});}));

findings.title: Preserve edits made while refreshing public terms
findings.suggested_fix: After intakePublicInfo resolves and the epoch is verified, read the still-live form and current acknowledgement again before rebuilding it; reset acknowledgement only when the exact terms version/hash changed. Alternatively avoid replacing the form at all for unchanged terms.

findings.title: Allow saving notes on an application already under review
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the same-status rejection for an under_review application while retaining expectedRevision and the submitted/under_review terminal-state guard, so saving another review note increments the revision and appends an immutable review event.
findings.first_evidence: harness/migrations/20261020-partnership-intake.sql:122 --     IF d.revision<>(p_payload->>'expectedRevision')::integer OR d.status NOT IN ('submitted','under_review') OR d.status=p_payload->>'decision' THEN PERFORM research_private.fail('conflict');END IF;

testing_gaps: The new intake SQL and HTTP-to-SQL tests use createPartnershipDatabase/createResearchDatabase, which do not enable the existing access_settings hardening or apply 20261019-research-auth-boundary.sql. The separate hardened-release test in harness/tests/research-security.test.mjs:39-42 applies only the pre-intake migrations. Extend that non-superuser release-order test with the two new migrations and public submission/owner approval/current-credential revocation checks so the new intake dispatcher is exercised with the deployed credential RLS policies.

findings.title: Compare the SQL intake contract with its source
findings.suggested_fix: Add a database contract test that SELECTs research_private.intake_contract() and deep-compares operations, publicFields, requiredFields, and defaultDraft with the corresponding research-intake-core exports, matching the existing partnership contract parity test.

findings.title: Test focus and page restoration event refresh
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the browser check with an acknowledged, filled form, publish a newer synthetic terms version, then trigger focus and persisted pageshow separately; assert the new version is displayed, the draft remains, and acknowledgement is unchecked without calling page.load directly.
findings.first_evidence: harness/tests/research-intake-ui.test.mjs:52 --   info={terms:{...terms,versionId:id(2),number:2,hash:'b'.repeat(64)},acceptingApplications:true};await page.load();assert.equal(field(s.root,'כותרת הבקשה').value,'מחקר סינתטי');assert.equal(field(s.root,'קראתי את תנאי הפנייה. אישור הקריאה אינו חתימה על הסכם').checked,false);assert.match(s.root.textContent,/התנאים עודכנו/);

residual_risks: The PGlite integration serializes database calls; it does not exercise the new advisory locks and idempotent approval under separate concurrent hosted PostgreSQL connections.

findings.title: Information Leakage: workspace projection hidden in source rewrite
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the pg_get_functiondef/replace/EXECUTE block with an explicit CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION partnership_workspace definition that includes study and grantedPermissions in its return object; preserve the previous function's visibility, released-version, consent, and document predicates verbatim, then rerun the database fixture tests.
findings.first_evidence: harness/migrations/20261020-partnership-intake.sql:154 -- definition:=pg_catalog.replace(definition,'''studyTitle'',s.config->>''title''','''studyTitle'',s.config->>''title'',''study'',pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(''id'',s.id,''status'',s.status,''revision'',s.revision,''config'',s.config),''grantedPermissions'',COALESCE((SELECT pg_catalog.to_jsonb(m.permissions) FROM research_private.memberships m WHERE m.study_id=s.id AND m.actor_ref=p.actor_ref),''[]''::jsonb)');

findings.title: Add the new intake page to the screens menu
findings.suggested_fix: Add research-partnership.html to the public gateway group in app/lib/screens-menu.js with who set to everyone, including visitors without sign-in; verify that this agrees with the page’s public access route.

findings.title: Intake approval replaces existing study grants
findings.suggested_fix: Before calling memberSet during intakeReview, lock and read the selected study/code membership, union its current permissions with the explicitly approved permissions, and pass that union to memberSet. Add a database test where an existing member retains an unrelated grant after a second intake approval for the same study.

testing_gaps: The migration and approval rollback are verified with isolated PGlite; concurrent owner approvals and terms publication have not been exercised against a multi-connection PostgreSQL deployment.

findings.title: Bound the new intake access-store calls
findings.suggested_fix: Pass a dedicated supabaseStore(url, key, { timeoutMs: 8000 }) to handleIntake in the new route, and keep injected authStore behavior bounded by the same intake deadline; verify a stalled access-store fetch returns unavailable within that deadline.
findings.first_evidence: harness/practice-server.mjs:200 -- const [status, out] = await handleIntake(jobStore(), supabaseResearchStore(url, key), body, { clientAddress: req.socket.remoteAddress });

findings.title: Time out a stalled public submission
findings.suggested_fix: Add a finite AbortController deadline to createPublicClient.call, clear its timer in finally, and retain pending.requestId on timeout; test that an unresolved fetch returns a network error and a retry reuses the same request ID.

findings.title: Existing studies disappear from the intake approval selector
findings.suggested_fix: Before mounting the intake owner page, fetch the existing authenticated core bootstrap action and pass its complete owner study list to mountOwner. Keep the partnership bootstrap for partnership permissions/readiness, and add a test that creates a study with no partners and selects it while approving the first intake application.
findings.first_evidence: app/lib/research-partnership-ui.js:37 --     async function openIntake(view,saved){if(!bootstrap?.owner)return;workspace=null;editor=null;intakePage=IUI.mountOwner({document,root,client,bootstrap,onBack:()=>load()});if(saved)await intakePage.restore(saved);else await intakePage[view]();}

findings.title: Terms refresh restores earlier edits and checked acknowledgement
findings.suggested_fix: After intakePublicInfo resolves and the epoch check passes, capture the current form data and current acknowledgement immediately before replacing the DOM. Reset acknowledgement when the exact terms version/hash changes. Add a deferred-response test that changes text and unchecks acknowledgement while a refresh is pending.

findings.title: Saving another review note always reports a conflict
findings.suggested_fix: Allow under_review to under_review in intakeReview when saving a further review note, incrementing the decision revision and appending an immutable intake_reviews row as for other reviews. Keep approved/rejected terminal and retain requestId replay and expectedRevision checks. Verify two consecutive review-note saves through the owner UI and SQL.
findings.first_evidence: harness/migrations/20261020-partnership-intake.sql:122 --     IF d.revision<>(p_payload->>'expectedRevision')::integer OR d.status NOT IN ('submitted','under_review') OR d.status=p_payload->>'decision' THEN PERFORM research_private.fail('conflict');END IF;

findings.title: Focus refresh discards edits made during the request
findings.suggested_fix: On a successful public-info response, compare the returned terms and availability with the displayed state; if unchanged, keep the live form. If a rerender is needed, call read() and capture ack.checked immediately before render() rather than before await client.call. Add a deferred-response UI test that types and checks acknowledgement between load() start and resolution.

findings.title: Late application detail response replaces a newer owner view
findings.suggested_fix: Increment a separate owner-view sequence at the start of inbox(), terms(), and detail(); capture it locally and check it after every awaited bootstrap or view request before changing route or replacing root. Include a deferred intakeGet response test that navigates to terms first and verifies terms remain visible.
